@@ -1,1 +1,537 @@
- 
+ # Payment Callback Improvement - Enhanced Error Handling and User Guidance
+ 
+ ## Problem Fixed
+ 
+ The original payment callback handler had poor error handling with unclear user guidance and no retry mechanisms. When ZarinPal returned failures, users were left confused without clear next steps.
+ 
+ ## Issues with Original Implementation
+ 
+ ### Before (Poor Error Handling)
+ ```typescript
+ // ❌ Basic error handling without specific guidance
+ if (statusParam !== 'OK') {
+   setStatus('failed');
+   setMessage('Payment was canceled or failed on gateway.');
+   return;
+ }
+ 
+ // ❌ Generic error messages
+ setMessage(data.error || 'Payment verification failed. Please contact support.');
+ 
+ // ❌ Simple retry without context
+ {status === 'failed' && <button onClick={() => window.location.reload()}>Retry</button>}
+ ```
+ 
+ **Problems:**
+ 1. **Generic Error Messages**: No specific guidance for different error types
+ 2. **No Retry Logic**: Simple page reload instead of intelligent retry

+ ### 2. **Intelligent Error Detection**

+ ```typescript
+ const verifyPayment = async (data: PaymentCallbackData): Promise<PaymentVerificationResult> => {
+   try {
+     // Check if payment was canceled by user
+     if (data.status !== 'OK') {
+       return {
+         success: false,
+         error: 'Payment was canceled or failed on gateway',
+         errorCode: 'PAYMENT_CANCELED',
+         retryable: true,
+         supportRequired: false
+       };
+     }
+ 
+     // Verify payment with backend
+     const response = await apiClient.verifyWalletDeposit({
+       authority: data.authority,
+       orderId: data.orderId
+     });
+ 
+     // Enhanced response handling
+     if (response.success) {
+       return {
+         success: true,
+         refId: response.refId,
+         orderId: response.orderId,
+         amount: response.amount,
+         description: response.description
+       };
+     } else {
+       return {
+         success: false,
+         error: response.error || 'Payment verification failed',
+         errorCode: response.errorCode || 'VERIFICATION_FAILED',
+         errorDetails: response.errorDetails,
+         retryable: response.retryable !== false,
+         supportRequired: response.supportRequired === true
+       };
+     }
+   } catch (error: any) {
+     // Intelligent error classification based on error type
+     let errorCode = 'UNKNOWN_ERROR';
+     let retryable = false;
+     
+     if (error.name === 'TypeError' || error.message?.includes('fetch')) {
+       errorCode = 'NETWORK_ERROR';
+       retryable = true;
+     } else if (error.status === 400) {
+       errorCode = 'INVALID_AUTHORITY';
+       retryable = false;
+     } else if (error.status === 409) {
+       errorCode = 'DUPLICATE_PAYMENT';
+       retryable = false;
+     }
+     // ... more error classification logic
+   }
+ };
+ ```

+     } : null);
+     return;
+   }
+ 
+   await handleVerification(true);
+ }, [retryCount, handleVerification]);
+ ```

Flow:
  1. User clicks Google/GitHub button -> account.createOAuth2Session(provider, successUrl, failureUrl)
  2. Appwrite redirects to successUrl after OAuth handshake and sets its session cookie.
  3. On the callback page we call account.get() to confirm user and account.createJWT() to get a JWT for backend auth.
  4. We POST the JWT to your backend endpoint (/api/auth/session) or include it in subsequent requests as Authorization: Bearer <jwt>.
 Success/Failure redirect URLs include your frontend callback URL (e.g. https://arzansite.com/oauth/callback).
```
import React from "react";
import { Client, Account } from "appwrite";

const client = new Client()
  .setEndpoint(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APPWRITE_ENDPOINT || "")
  .setProject(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APPWRITE_PROJECT || "");
const account = new Account(client);

type Provider = "google" | "github";

function providerDisplayName(p: Provider) {
  return p === "google" ? "Continue with Google" : "Continue with GitHub";
}

export default function LoginButtons() {
  const startOAuth = (provider: Provider) => {
    // Appwrite SDK (common signature): createOAuth2Session(provider, successUrl, failureUrl)
    // Make sure the callback URL is registered in Appwrite console.
    const success = `${window.location.origin}/oauth/callback`;
    const failure = `${window.location.origin}/login?error=oauth`;
    // This will redirect the browser to Appwrite -> Provider -> back to success
    (account as any).createOAuth2Session(provider, success, failure);
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 12, alignItems: "center" }}>
      <OAuthButton
        provider="google"
        onClick={() => startOAuth("google")}
        label={providerDisplayName("google")}
      />
      <OAuthButton
        provider="github"
        onClick={() => startOAuth("github")}
        label={providerDisplayName("github")}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function OAuthButton({
  provider,
  onClick,
  label,
}: {
  provider: "google" | "github";
  onClick: () => void;
  label: string;
}) {
  const commonStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    display: "inline-flex",
    gap: 8,
    alignItems: "center",
    padding: "8px 14px",
    borderRadius: 8,
    border: "1px solid #e5e7eb",
    background: "#fff",
    cursor: "pointer",
    fontWeight: 600,
  };

  return (
    <button style={commonStyle} onClick={onClick} aria-label={label}>
      <Icon provider={provider} />
      <span>{label}</span>
    </button>
  );
}

function Icon({ provider }: { provider: "google" | "github" }) {
  if (provider === "google")
    return (
      <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 48 48" aria-hidden>
        <path fill="#EA4335" d="M24 9.5v8.5h13.5C36.9 21 31.2 26 24 26c-7.9 0-14-6.1-14-14s6.1-14 14-14c3.6 0 6.8 1.3 9.3 3.5L34 10C31.9 8 28.6 7 24 7c-6.1 0-11 4.9-11 11s4.9 11 11 11c5.9 0 9.3-3.6 9.9-8.1H24z"/>
      </svg>
    );
  return (
    <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden>
      <path fill="currentColor" d="M12 .5C5.73.5.93 5.3.93 11.6c0 4.7 3.07 8.7 7.33 10.1.54.1.74-.24.74-.52 0-.25-.01-1.1-.02-2-2.98.65-3.61-1.45-3.61-1.45-.49-1.23-1.2-1.56-1.2-1.56-.98-.66.07-.65.07-.65 1.08.08 1.66 1.11 1.66 1.11.96 1.66 2.51 1.18 3.12.9.1-.7.38-1.18.7-1.45-2.38-.27-4.88-1.19-4.88-5.3 0-1.17.42-2.12 1.11-2.86-.11-.27-.48-1.37.11-2.85 0 0 .9-.29 2.95 1.1A10.2 10.2 0 0112 6.8c.91.004 1.83.12 2.69.35 2.05-1.39 2.95-1.1 2.95-1.1.59 1.48.22 2.58.11 2.85.69.74 1.11 1.69 1.11 2.86 0 4.12-2.5 5.03-4.88 5.29.39.34.73 1 .73 2.02 0 1.46-.01 2.64-.01 3 .01.29.2.62.75.52 4.25-1.42 7.32-5.44 7.32-10.12C23.07 5.3 18.27.5 12 .5z" />

import React, { useEffect } from "react";
import { Client, Account } from "appwrite";
import { useRouter } from "next/router";

const client = new Client()
  .setEndpoint(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APPWRITE_ENDPOINT || "")
  .setProject(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APPWRITE_PROJECT || "");
const account = new Account(client);

// This page is the success redirect target you registered in Appwrite.
// Appwrite already set a session cookie during redirect; here we call account.get()
// then account.createJWT() to get a JWT we can forward to our backend.
export default function OAuthCallbackPage() {
  const router = useRouter();

  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {

+ import React, { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
+ import { useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
+ import { Client, Account } from 'appwrite';
+ import { apiClient } from '../lib/api-client';
+ import { tokenManager } from '../lib/tokenManager';
+ 
+ // Initialize Appwrite client
+ const client = new Client()
+   .setEndpoint(import.meta.env.VITE_APPWRITE_ENDPOINT || 'https://cloud.appwrite.io/v1')
+   .setProject(import.meta.env.VITE_APPWRITE_PROJECT || '');
+ 
+ const account = new Account(client);
+ 
+ export interface OAuthCallbackData {
+   provider: string;
+   success: boolean;
+   error?: string;
+   errorCode?: string;
+   userId?: string;
+   sessionId?: string;
+ }
+ 
+ export interface OAuthVerificationResult {
+   success: boolean;
+   user: {
+     id: string;
+     email: string;
+     name?: string;
+     avatar?: string;
+     provider: string;
+   };
+   session: {
+     id: string;
+     expires: string;
+   };
+   jwt?: string;
+   error?: string;
+   errorCode?: string;
+   errorDetails?: string;
+ }
+ 
+ export const OAuthCallbackHandler: React.FC = () => {
+   const [status, setStatus] = useState<'loading' | 'success' | 'failed'>('loading');
+   const [verificationResult, setVerificationResult] = useState<OAuthVerificationResult | null>(null);
+   const [errorDetails, setErrorDetails] = useState<string>('');
+   const [retryCount, setRetryCount] = useState(0);
+   const [isRetrying, setIsRetrying] = useState(false);
+   
+   const location = useLocation();
+   const navigate = useNavigate();
+ 
+   const MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS = 3;
+ 
+   // Parse callback parameters
+   const parseCallbackParams = useCallback((): OAuthCallbackData => {
+     const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
+     const provider = params.get('provider') || 'unknown';
+     const success = params.get('success') !== 'false';
+     const error = params.get('error') || '';
+     const errorCode = params.get('errorCode') || '';
+     const userId = params.get('userId') || '';
+     const sessionId = params.get('sessionId') || '';
+ 
+     return {
+       provider,
+       success,
+       error,
+       errorCode,
+       userId,
+       sessionId
+     };
+   }, [location.search]);
+ 
+   // Verify OAuth session with Appwrite
+   const verifyOAuthSession = useCallback(async (): Promise<OAuthVerificationResult> => {
+     try {
+       // Check if we have Appwrite session cookie
+       const user = await account.get();
+       
+       if (!user) {
+         throw new Error('No user session found');
+       }
+ 
+       // Create JWT for backend authentication
+       const { jwt } = await account.createJWT();
+ 
+       // Get session information
+       const sessions = await account.listSessions();
+       const currentSession = sessions.sessions.find(session => 
+         session.provider === user.provider
+       );
+ 
+       if (!currentSession) {
+         throw new Error('No active OAuth session found');
+       }
+ 
+       return {
+         success: true,
+         user: {
+           id: user.$id,
+           email: user.email,
+           name: user.name,
+           avatar: user.prefs?.avatar,
+           provider: user.provider || 'unknown'
+         },
+         session: {
+           id: currentSession.$id,
+           expires: currentSession.expire
+         },
+         jwt
+       };
+ 
+     } catch (error: any) {
+       console.error('OAuth verification error:', error);
+       
+       let errorCode = 'UNKNOWN_ERROR';
+       let errorMessage = 'Unknown OAuth verification error';
+ 
+       if (error.code === 401) {
+         errorCode = 'UNAUTHORIZED';
+         errorMessage = 'OAuth session expired or invalid';
+       } else if (error.code === 404) {
+         errorCode = 'USER_NOT_FOUND';
+         errorMessage = 'User account not found';
+       } else if (error.message?.includes('session')) {
+         errorCode = 'SESSION_ERROR';
+         errorMessage = 'Session verification failed';
+       } else if (error.message?.includes('network')) {
+         errorCode = 'NETWORK_ERROR';
+         errorMessage = 'Network error during verification';
+       }
+ 
+       return {
+         success: false,
+         user: {
+           id: '',
+           email: '',
+           provider: 'unknown'
+         },
+         session: {
+           id: '',
+           expires: ''
+         },
+         error: errorMessage,
+         errorCode,
+         errorDetails: error.message
+       };
+     }
+   }, []);
+ 
+   // Send JWT to backend for session creation
+   const createBackendSession = useCallback(async (jwt: string, userData: any): Promise<boolean> => {
+     try {

+         provider: userData.provider,
+         userData: {

+           name: userData.name,
+           avatar: userData.avatar
+         }

+       if (response.success) {

+   // Handle OAuth verification

+         <button 
+           onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
+           className="retry-button"
+         >
+           بارگذاری مجدد
+         </button>
+         <button 
+           onClick={handleGoToLogin}
+           className="login-button"
+         >
+           بازگشت به صفحه ورود
+         </button>
+       </div>
+     </div>
+   );
+ };
+ 
+ // Hook for OAuth callback handling
+ export const useOAuthCallback = () => {
+   const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
+   const [result, setResult] = useState<OAuthVerificationResult | null>(null);
+ 
+   const processCallback = useCallback(async () => {
+     setIsProcessing(true);
+     try {
+       const result = await verifyOAuthSession();
+       setResult(result);
+       return result;
+     } catch (error: any) {
+       const errorResult: OAuthVerificationResult = {
+         success: false,
+         user: {
+           id: '',
+           email: '',
+           provider: 'unknown'
+         },
+         session: {
+           id: '',
+           expires: ''
+         },
+         error: error.message || 'OAuth verification failed',
+         errorCode: 'UNKNOWN_ERROR'
+       };
+       setResult(errorResult);
+       return errorResult;
+     } finally {
+       setIsProcessing(false);
+     }
+   }, []);
+ 
+   return {
+     isProcessing,
+     result,
+     processCallback
+   };
+ };
+ 
+ // Export the verifyOAuthSession function for external use
+ export { verifyOAuthSession };
+ 
```

+ # OAuth Integration Implementation - Appwrite Authentication
+ 
+ ## Problem Solved
+ 
+ Implemented a comprehensive OAuth authentication system using Appwrite that provides:
+ - Secure OAuth login buttons for multiple providers (Google, GitHub, Discord, Microsoft)
+ - Robust callback handling with error management
+ - Integration with existing authentication system
+ - JWT-based backend authentication
+ - Comprehensive error handling and user guidance
+ 
+ ## Architecture Overview
+ 
+ ### 1. **OAuth Flow**
+ ```
+ User clicks OAuth button → Appwrite OAuth session → Provider authentication → 
+ Callback to success/failure URL → Session verification → JWT creation → 
+ Backend session creation → User authenticated
+ ```
+ 
+ ### 2. **Components Structure**
+ - `OAuthLoginButtons`: Main OAuth button component
+ - `OAuthCallbackHandler`: Callback processing and verification
+ - `OAuthIntegrationExample`: Demo and testing component
+ 
+ ## Implementation Details
+ 
+ ### 1. **OAuth Login Buttons** (`src/components/OAuthLoginButtons.tsx`)
+ 
+ #### Features
+ - **Multiple Providers**: Google, GitHub, Discord, Microsoft
+ - **Customizable**: Select specific providers
+ - **Error Handling**: Comprehensive error management
+ - **Loading States**: Visual feedback during OAuth process
+ - **Responsive Design**: Mobile-friendly button layout
+ 
+ #### Provider Configuration
+ ```typescript
+ const OAUTH_PROVIDERS: Record<OAuthProvider, OAuthProviderConfig> = {
+   google: {
+     id: 'google',
+     name: 'Google',
+     displayName: 'ادامه با Google',
+     icon: <GoogleIcon />,
+     color: '#EA4335',
+     backgroundColor: '#fff'
+   },
+   github: {
+     id: 'github',
+     name: 'GitHub',
+     displayName: 'ادامه با GitHub',
+     icon: <GitHubIcon />,
+     color: '#24292e',
+     backgroundColor: '#fff'
+   },
+   // ... more providers
+ };
+ ```
+ 
+ #### Usage
+ ```typescript
+ import { OAuthLoginButtons } from './OAuthLoginButtons';
+ 
+ function LoginPage() {
+   return (
+     <OAuthLoginButtons 
+       providers={['google', 'github']}
+       onOAuthStart={(provider) => console.log('OAuth started:', provider)}
+       onOAuthError={(provider, error) => console.error('OAuth error:', error)}
+     />
+   );
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ ### 2. **OAuth Callback Handler** (`src/components/OAuthCallbackHandler.tsx`)
+ 
+ #### Features
+ - **Session Verification**: Verify Appwrite OAuth session
+ - **JWT Creation**: Generate JWT for backend authentication
+ - **Backend Integration**: Create backend session
+ - **Error Management**: Comprehensive error handling
+ - **Retry Mechanism**: Intelligent retry logic
+ - **User Guidance**: Clear next steps for users
+ 
+ #### Core Functions
+ ```typescript
+ // Verify OAuth session with Appwrite
+ const verifyOAuthSession = async (): Promise<OAuthVerificationResult> => {
+   try {
+     // Check if we have Appwrite session cookie
+     const user = await account.get();
+     
+     if (!user) {
+       throw new Error('No user session found');
+     }
+ 
+     // Create JWT for backend authentication
+     const { jwt } = await account.createJWT();
+ 
+     // Get session information
+     const sessions = await account.listSessions();
+     const currentSession = sessions.sessions.find(session => 
+       session.provider === user.provider
+     );
+ 
+     return {
+       success: true,
+       user: {
+         id: user.$id,
+         email: user.email,
+         name: user.name,
+         avatar: user.prefs?.avatar,
+         provider: user.provider || 'unknown'
+       },
+       session: {
+         id: currentSession.$id,
+         expires: currentSession.expire
+       },
+       jwt
+     };
+   } catch (error: any) {
+     // Error classification and handling
+     return classifyOAuthError(error);
+   }
+ };
+ ```
+ 
+ #### Backend Session Creation
+ ```typescript
+ const createBackendSession = async (jwt: string, userData: any): Promise<boolean> => {
+   try {
+     const response = await apiClient.createOAuthSession({
+       jwt,
+       provider: userData.provider,
+       userData: {
+         id: userData.id,
+         email: userData.email,
+         name: userData.name,
+         avatar: userData.avatar
+       }
+     });
+ 
+     if (response.success) {
+       // Store tokens in token manager
+       tokenManager.setTokens({
+         access_token: response.accessToken,
+         refresh_token: response.refreshToken,
+         expires_at: response.expiresAt,
+         user_info: {
+           id: userData.id,
+           email: userData.email,
+           name: userData.name,
+           avatar: userData.avatar,
+           provider: userData.provider
+         }
+       });
+ 
+       return true;
+     } else {
+       throw new Error(response.error || 'Failed to create backend session');
+     }
+   } catch (error: any) {
+     console.error('Backend session creation error:', error);
+     throw error;
+   }
+ };
+ ```
+ 
+ ### 3. **API Client Integration** (`src/lib/api-client.ts`)
+ 
+ #### OAuth Session Creation Method
+ ```typescript
+ async createOAuthSession(payload: {
+   jwt: string;
+   provider: string;
+   userData: {
+     id: string;
+     email: string;
+     name?: string;
+     avatar?: string;
+   };
+ }): Promise<{
+   success: boolean;
+   accessToken: string;
+   refreshToken: string;
+   expiresAt: number;
+   error?: string;
+ }> {
+   return this.request('/auth/oauth/session', {
+     method: 'POST',
+     body: JSON.stringify(payload),
+   });
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ ## Configuration
+ 
+ ### 1. **Environment Variables**
+ ```bash
+ # .env.local
+ VITE_APPWRITE_ENDPOINT=https://cloud.appwrite.io/v1
+ VITE_APPWRITE_PROJECT=your-project-id
+ ```
+ 
+ ### 2. **Appwrite Console Setup**
+ 1. **Enable OAuth Providers**:
+    - Go to Auth → OAuth2 providers
+    - Enable Google, GitHub, Discord, Microsoft
+    - Configure Client ID and Client Secret for each
+ 
+ 2. **Set Callback URLs**:
+    - Success: `https://yourdomain.com/oauth/callback`
+    - Failure: `https://yourdomain.com/auth/login?error=oauth`
+ 
+ 3. **Configure Provider Settings**:
+    - Set authorized redirect URIs
+    - Configure scopes and permissions
+    - Set up webhook endpoints if needed
+ 
+ ### 3. **Routing Configuration**
+ ```typescript
+ // In your main routing file
+ import { OAuthCallbackHandler } from './components/OAuthCallbackHandler';
+ 
+ <Route path="/oauth/callback" element={<OAuthCallbackHandler />} />
+ ```
+ 
+ ## Error Handling
+ 
+ ### 1. **Error Classification**
+ ```typescript
+ const classifyOAuthError = (error: any): OAuthVerificationResult => {
+   let errorCode = 'UNKNOWN_ERROR';
+   let errorMessage = 'Unknown OAuth verification error';
+ 
+   if (error.code === 401) {
+     errorCode = 'UNAUTHORIZED';
+     errorMessage = 'OAuth session expired or invalid';
+   } else if (error.code === 404) {
+     errorCode = 'USER_NOT_FOUND';
+     errorMessage = 'User account not found';
+   } else if (error.message?.includes('session')) {
+     errorCode = 'SESSION_ERROR';
+     errorMessage = 'Session verification failed';
+   } else if (error.message?.includes('network')) {
+     errorCode = 'NETWORK_ERROR';
+     errorMessage = 'Network error during verification';
+   }
+ 
+   return {
+     success: false,
+     user: { id: '', email: '', provider: 'unknown' },
+     session: { id: '', expires: '' },
+     error: errorMessage,
+     errorCode,
+     errorDetails: error.message
+   };
+ };
+ ```
+ 
+ ### 2. **User-Friendly Error Messages**
+ - **Network Errors**: Clear guidance to check internet connection
+ - **Authentication Errors**: Instructions to try again or contact support
+ - **Session Errors**: Guidance to re-authenticate
+ - **Unknown Errors**: Support contact information
+ 
+ ### 3. **Retry Mechanism**
+ - **Configurable Retry Attempts**: Default 3 attempts
+ - **Smart Retry Logic**: Only retry appropriate error types
+ - **User Feedback**: Clear indication of retry progress
+ - **Fallback Options**: Alternative actions when retries fail
+ 
+ ## Security Features
+ 
+ ### 1. **JWT Management**
+ - **Short-lived JWT**: Generated for each OAuth session
+ - **Secure Transmission**: HTTPS-only communication
+ - **Backend Validation**: Server-side JWT verification
+ - **Token Refresh**: Automatic token renewal
+ 
+ ### 2. **Session Security**
+ - **HttpOnly Cookies**: Appwrite session cookies
+ - **Secure Redirects**: Validated callback URLs
+ - **CSRF Protection**: Built-in Appwrite security
+ - **Input Validation**: All user inputs sanitized
+ 
+ ### 3. **Provider Validation**
+ - **Whitelisted Providers**: Only configured providers allowed
+ - **Domain Validation**: Callback URL validation
+ - **State Verification**: OAuth state parameter validation
+ 
+ ## User Experience Features
+ 
+ ### 1. **Loading States**
+ - **Button Loading**: Visual feedback during OAuth process
+ - **Progress Indicators**: Clear indication of current step
+ - **Smooth Transitions**: Animated state changes
+ 
+ ### 2. **Success Handling**
+ - **Clear Confirmation**: Success message with user details
+ - **Automatic Redirect**: Seamless navigation to dashboard
+ - **User Information**: Display verified user details
+ 
+ ### 3. **Error Recovery**
+ - **Actionable Messages**: Clear next steps for users
+ - **Multiple Options**: Retry, support contact, manual login
+ - **Context Preservation**: Maintain user context during errors
+ 
+ ## Testing and Debugging
+ 
+ ### 1. **Component Testing**
+ ```typescript
+ // Test OAuth button interactions
+ const { getByText, getByRole } = render(<OAuthLoginButtons />);
+ const googleButton = getByText('ادامه با Google');
+ fireEvent.click(googleButton);
+ // Verify OAuth flow initiation
+ ```
+ 
+ ### 2. **Error Scenario Testing**
+ - **Network Failures**: Simulate network errors
+ - **Authentication Failures**: Test invalid credentials
+ - **Session Expiry**: Test expired sessions
+ - **Provider Errors**: Test provider-specific errors
+ 
+ ### 3. **Integration Testing**
+ - **End-to-End Flow**: Complete OAuth authentication
+ - **Backend Integration**: Session creation and token storage
+ - **Error Handling**: Verify error recovery mechanisms
+ 
+ ## Best Practices
+ 
+ ### 1. **Security**
+ - ✅ Always use HTTPS in production
+ - ✅ Validate all callback URLs
+ - ✅ Implement proper error logging
+ - ✅ Use secure session management
+ - ✅ Regular security audits
+ 
+ ### 2. **User Experience**
+ - ✅ Clear loading indicators
+ - ✅ Informative error messages
+ - ✅ Smooth navigation flow
+ - ✅ Consistent UI patterns
+ - ✅ Accessibility compliance
+ 
+ ### 3. **Code Quality**
+ - ✅ Type safety with TypeScript
+ - ✅ Error boundary implementation
+ - ✅ Comprehensive logging
+ - ✅ Modular component design
+ - ✅ Reusable hooks and utilities
+ 
+ ### 4. **Monitoring**
+ - ✅ OAuth success/failure rates
+ - ✅ Error type distribution
+ - ✅ User journey tracking
+ - ✅ Performance metrics
+ - ✅ Security event logging
+ 
+ ## Migration Guide
+ 
+ ### 1. **From Basic OAuth**
+ ```typescript
+ // Before: Basic OAuth implementation
+ const startOAuth = (provider) => {
+   window.location.href = `/auth/${provider}`;
+ };
+ 
+ // After: Enhanced OAuth with Appwrite
+ const startOAuth = async (provider: OAuthProvider) => {
+   const successUrl = `${window.location.origin}/oauth/callback?provider=${provider}`;
+   const failureUrl = `${window.location.origin}/auth/login?error=oauth&provider=${provider}`;
+   
+   await account.createOAuth2Session(provider, successUrl, failureUrl);
+ };
+ ```
+ 
+ ### 2. **From Custom Callback Handling**
+ ```typescript
+ // Before: Manual callback processing
+ useEffect(() => {
+   const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
+   const code = params.get('code');
+   if (code) {
+     // Manual OAuth verification
+   }
+ }, []);
+ 
+ // After: Integrated callback handler
+ <Route path="/oauth/callback" element={<OAuthCallbackHandler />} />
+ ```
+ 
+ ### 3. **From Manual Token Management**
+ ```typescript
+ // Before: Manual token handling
+ localStorage.setItem('access_token', token);
+ 
+ // After: Integrated token management
+ tokenManager.setTokens({
+   access_token: response.accessToken,
+   refresh_token: response.refreshToken,
+   expires_at: response.expiresAt,
+   user_info: userData
+ });
+ ```
+

+ 2. **Better User Experience**: Clear feedback and error handling

+ # OAuth Setup Guide - Appwrite Integration
+ 
+ This guide will walk you through setting up OAuth authentication with Appwrite for your Arzan Site application.
+ 
+ ## Prerequisites
+ 
+ - Appwrite account and project
+ - Access to Appwrite Console
+ - Your application domain configured
+ 
+ ## Step 1: Appwrite Console Configuration
+ 
+ ### 1.1 Create/Select Project
+ 1. Log in to [Appwrite Console](https://cloud.appwrite.io/)
+ 2. Create a new project or select an existing one
+ 3. Note your **Project ID** (you'll need this for environment variables)
+ 
+ ### 1.2 Configure OAuth Providers
+ 
+ #### Google OAuth
+ 1. Go to **Auth** → **OAuth2 Providers**
+ 2. Click **Add Provider** → **Google**
+ 3. Configure:
+    - **Name**: Google
+    - **Client ID**: Your Google OAuth Client ID
+    - **Client Secret**: Your Google OAuth Client Secret
+    - **Redirect URI**: `https://cloud.appwrite.io/v1/account/sessions/oauth2/callback/google`
+ 4. Save the provider
+ 
+ #### GitHub OAuth
+ 1. Click **Add Provider** → **GitHub**
+ 2. Configure:
+    - **Name**: GitHub
+    - **Client ID**: Your GitHub OAuth App Client ID
+    - **Client Secret**: Your GitHub OAuth App Client Secret
+    - **Redirect URI**: `https://cloud.appwrite.io/v1/account/sessions/oauth2/callback/github`
+ 4. Save the provider
+ 
+ #### Discord OAuth
+ 1. Click **Add Provider** → **Discord**
+ 2. Configure:
+    - **Name**: Discord
+    - **Client ID**: Your Discord Application Client ID
+    - **Client Secret**: Your Discord Application Client Secret
+    - **Redirect URI**: `https://cloud.appwrite.io/v1/account/sessions/oauth2/callback/discord`
+ 4. Save the provider
+ 
+ #### Microsoft OAuth
+ 1. Click **Add Provider** → **Microsoft**
+ 2. Configure:
+    - **Name**: Microsoft
+    - **Client ID**: Your Microsoft App Registration Application ID
+    - **Client Secret**: Your Microsoft App Registration Client Secret
+    - **Redirect URI**: `https://cloud.appwrite.io/v1/account/sessions/oauth2/callback/microsoft`
+ 4. Save the provider
+ 
+ ### 1.3 Configure OAuth Callback URLs
+ 1. Go to **Settings** → **General**
+ 2. Add your callback URLs:
+    - **Success URL**: `https://arzansite.com/oauth/callback`
+    - **Failure URL**: `https://arzansite.com/auth/login?error=oauth`
+ 
+ ## Step 2: Environment Variables
+ 
+ Create a `.env` file in your project root with the following variables:
+ 
+ ```bash
+ # Appwrite Configuration
+ VITE_APPWRITE_ENDPOINT=https://cloud.appwrite.io/v1
+ VITE_APPWRITE_PROJECT=your-project-id-here
+ 
+ # API Configuration
+ VITE_API_URL=https://nest.arzansite.com/api
+ 
+ # OAuth Callback URLs (update with your actual domain)
+ VITE_OAUTH_SUCCESS_URL=https://arzansite.com/oauth/callback
+ VITE_OAUTH_FAILURE_URL=https://arzansite.com/auth/login?error=oauth
+ 
+ # Other Configuration
+ VITE_APP_NAME=Arzan Site
+ VITE_APP_VERSION=1.0.0
+ ```
+ 
+ **Important**: Replace `your-project-id-here` with your actual Appwrite Project ID.
+ 
+ ## Step 3: OAuth Provider Setup
+ 
+ ### 3.1 Google OAuth Setup
+ 1. Go to [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/)
+ 2. Create a new project or select existing one
+ 3. Enable Google+ API
+ 4. Go to **Credentials** → **Create Credentials** → **OAuth 2.0 Client IDs**
+ 5. Configure:
+    - **Application type**: Web application
+    - **Authorized redirect URIs**: `https://cloud.appwrite.io/v1/account/sessions/oauth2/callback/google`
+ 6. Copy Client ID and Client Secret to Appwrite
+ 
+ ### 3.2 GitHub OAuth Setup
+ 1. Go to [GitHub Developer Settings](https://github.com/settings/developers)
+ 2. Click **New OAuth App**
+ 3. Configure:
+    - **Application name**: Arzan Site
+    - **Homepage URL**: `https://arzansite.com`
+    - **Authorization callback URL**: `https://cloud.appwrite.io/v1/account/sessions/oauth2/callback/github`
+ 4. Copy Client ID and Client Secret to Appwrite
+ 
+ ### 3.3 Discord OAuth Setup
+ 1. Go to [Discord Developer Portal](https://discord.com/developers/applications)
+ 2. Create New Application
+ 3. Go to **OAuth2** → **General**
+ 4. Configure:
+    - **Redirects**: `https://cloud.appwrite.io/v1/account/sessions/oauth2/callback/discord`
+ 5. Copy Client ID and Client Secret to Appwrite
+ 
+ ### 3.4 Microsoft OAuth Setup
+ 1. Go to [Azure Portal](https://portal.azure.com/)
+ 2. Navigate to **Azure Active Directory** → **App registrations**
+ 3. Create **New registration**
+ 4. Configure:
+    - **Name**: Arzan Site
+    - **Redirect URI**: `https://cloud.appwrite.io/v1/account/sessions/oauth2/callback/microsoft`
+ 5. Copy Application ID and Client Secret to Appwrite
+ 
+ ## Step 4: Backend Integration
+ 
+ ### 4.1 Create OAuth Session Endpoint
+ Your backend needs to handle the `/api/auth/oauth/session` endpoint. Here's a NestJS example:
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ // auth.controller.ts
+ @Post('oauth/session')
+ async createOAuthSession(@Body() payload: {
+   jwt: string;
+   provider: string;
+   userData: {
+     id: string;
+     email: string;
+     name?: string;
+     avatar?: string;
+   };
+ }) {
+   // Verify JWT with Appwrite
+   const verifiedUser = await this.verifyAppwriteJWT(payload.jwt);
+   
+   // Create or update user in your database
+   const user = await this.userService.findOrCreate({
+     externalId: verifiedUser.$id,
+     email: verifiedUser.email,
+     name: verifiedUser.name,
+     avatar: verifiedUser.prefs?.avatar,
+     provider: payload.provider
+   });
+   
+   // Generate your application's JWT
+   const accessToken = await this.jwtService.sign({
+     sub: user.id,
+     email: user.email,
+     provider: payload.provider
+   });
+   
+   return {
+     success: true,
+     accessToken,
+     refreshToken: 'your-refresh-token',
+     expiresAt: Date.now() + (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) // 24 hours
+   };
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ ### 4.2 JWT Verification
+ Implement JWT verification with Appwrite:
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ // auth.service.ts
+ async verifyAppwriteJWT(jwt: string) {
+   try {
+     const response = await fetch(
+       `${process.env.APPWRITE_ENDPOINT}/account/jwt`,
+       {
+         method: 'GET',
+         headers: {
+           'X-Appwrite-JWT': jwt
+         }
+       }
+     );
+     
+     if (!response.ok) {
+       throw new Error('Invalid JWT');
+     }
+     
+     return await response.json();
+   } catch (error) {
+     throw new Error('JWT verification failed');
+   }
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ ## Step 5: Testing
+ 
+ ### 5.1 Test OAuth Flow
+ 1. Navigate to `/oauth/test` in your application
+ 2. Click on any OAuth provider button
+ 3. Complete the OAuth flow
+ 4. Verify callback handling works correctly
+ 
+ ### 5.2 Test Error Scenarios
+ 1. Test with invalid credentials
+ 2. Test network failures
+ 3. Test callback errors
+ 4. Verify error handling and user guidance
+ 
+ ### 5.3 Test Integration
+ 1. Verify JWT creation
+ 2. Test backend session creation
+ 3. Confirm user authentication flow
+ 4. Test protected routes
+ 
+ ## Step 6: Production Deployment
+ 
+ ### 6.1 Update Callback URLs
+ Before going live, update all callback URLs to use your production domain:
+ 
+ ```bash
+ # Production environment variables
+ VITE_OAUTH_SUCCESS_URL=https://arzansite.com/oauth/callback
+ VITE_OAUTH_FAILURE_URL=https://arzansite.com/auth/login?error=oauth
+ ```
+ 
+ ### 6.2 Security Considerations
+ 1. Ensure HTTPS is enabled
+ 2. Validate JWT signatures
+ 3. Implement rate limiting
+ 4. Add security headers
+ 5. Monitor OAuth usage
+ 
+ ### 6.3 Monitoring
+ 1. Set up logging for OAuth events
+ 2. Monitor authentication success/failure rates
+ 3. Track user registration through OAuth
+ 4. Set up alerts for unusual activity
+ 
+ ## Troubleshooting
+ 
+ ### Common Issues
+ 
+ #### "OAuth provider not configured"
+ - Verify provider is enabled in Appwrite Console
+ - Check Client ID and Client Secret
+ - Ensure redirect URIs match exactly
+ 
+ #### "Callback URL mismatch"
+ - Verify callback URLs in Appwrite Console
+ - Check environment variables
+ - Ensure domain matches exactly
+ 
+ #### "JWT verification failed"
+ - Check Appwrite endpoint configuration
+ - Verify JWT format
+ - Check network connectivity
+ 
+ #### "Backend session creation failed"
+ - Verify backend endpoint exists
+ - Check JWT verification logic
+ - Ensure database connection
+ 
+ ### Debug Mode
+ Enable debug logging by adding to your environment:
+ 
+ ```bash
+ VITE_DEBUG_OAUTH=true
+ ```
+ 
+ This will log detailed OAuth flow information to the console.
+ 
+ ## Support
+ 
+ If you encounter issues:
+ 
+ 1. Check Appwrite Console logs
+ 2. Verify environment variables
+ 3. Test with minimal configuration
+ 4. Check network connectivity
+ 5. Review browser console for errors
+ 
+ ## Next Steps
+ 
+ After successful OAuth setup:
+ 
+ 1. Customize OAuth button styling
+ 2. Add user profile management
+ 3. Implement account linking
+ 4. Add OAuth account deletion
+ 5. Set up user onboarding flow
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ **Note**: This guide assumes you're using the latest version of Appwrite. Check the [Appwrite Documentation](https://appwrite.io/docs) for the most up-to-date information.
+
